scripts.title: Fast Train
scripts.features: Allows you to train really (and I mean REALLY) fast, at a configurable rate.
scripts.script:
--- {settings} ---
local TrainPriority = 0 -- time to wait when binding stuff with runservice (priority = time to wait basically)
local EvenFasterTraining = false
--------------------------------------------------------------

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local CurrentWorld = Player["worlds"].currentworld

local Benchpress = nil
local CurrentMap = nil

for num, item in workspace.maps:GetChildren() do
	if item.Name:gsub("%D", "") == CurrentWorld.Value:gsub("%D", "") then
		CurrentMap = item
		Benchpress = CurrentMap.training.benchpress
	end
end

game.RunService:BindToRenderStep("FastTrain", TrainPriority, function()

local omginstance1 = Benchpress
local omgboolean2 = true

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").remotes.train:FireServer(omginstance1, omgboolean2)

local omginstance1 = Benchpress
local omgboolean2 = EvenFasterTraining

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").remotes.train:FireServer(omginstance1, omgboolean2)
end)

scripts.title: Infinity Yield
scripts.features:
Infinite Yield is a popular universal administrative script used in Roblox. It provides users with a vast array of commands that grant "admin-like" abilities in almost any game. Its primary appeal lies in its versatility and the fact that it doesn't require the user to have official permissions from the game owner.

The script features a command bar and a graphical interface where users can search for and execute hundreds of different functions. Some of its most common capabilities include flying, walking through walls (noclip), increasing movement speed, and viewing other players through walls (ESP). It also supports custom plugins, which allows the community to extend its functionality even further.

However, using Infinite Yield is a violation of the Roblox Terms of Service. Because it involves third-party software to inject code into the game client, users face a significant risk of being banned. Additionally, the software used to run such scripts can often contain security risks for the user's computer.
